ruleDefinitions.name: New Superuser Account Creation Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Linux Privileged Account Creation or Modification

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create" AND(  process_command_line:RGXi("(useradd|adduser)")  OR  (  process_command_line:RGXi("uermod")   AND process_command_line:RGXi("(-aG|-G|-g )")  )  OR  (   process_command_line:RGXi("gpaswd")   AND process_command_line:RGXi("(-a )") ) AND  process_command_line:RGXi(" 0 ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("wheel")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("sudo"))
AND NOT user="root"
AND NOT parent_process_name:("puppet","chef","ansible","salt","cloud-init")
